Hi Rishi,

Appreciate the MAP — useful starting point. A few clarifications from our side:

- Primary success metrics:
  * Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for single-turn queries under our test harness (50 rps).
  * Accuracy: Precision@1 for our reranking test >= 78% on the baseline dataset (shared).
  * Cost: projected production cost <= $0.0025 per token for our median request size.

- Exit gates: SOC2 evidence + answers to our data retention questions, a perf run that demonstrates sustained 40 RPS for 3 minutes with <500ms p95, and legal approval of the standard SOW terms.

- Decision timeline: procurement would like a recommendation by Dec 19, 2025.

I'll loop in our security lead (Marcus Hale) for the SOC2 / data handling review. He may ask for logs/retention settings during the security checkpoint.

Can you add specific acceptance tests (what we will run and pass/fail criteria) to the MAP? Also please include what 'graceful degradation' looks like in a failover scenario.

Thanks,

FinLytics Inc.

Thanks for the fast turnaround — the attached security questionnaire and your acceptance matrix look good. A few concrete items we want included in the MAP before we call the kick-off:

1) Acceptance tests (we will run these and mark pass/fail):
   - Integration test: API end-to-end for 1k sample queries; pass if 99% successful responses and no PII leakage flags.
   - Perf test (baseline): 50 RPS sustained for 2 minutes, p95 < 350ms.
   - Stress test: 40 RPS for 3 minutes, <500ms p95 and no request errors >0.5%.
   - Quality test: Precision@1 >= 78% on our rerank dataset (scoring script attached).
   - Security checklist: SOC2 report provided OR equivalent audit statements; data retention config set to 30 days for logs and immediate deletion of raw uploads after processing.

2) Exit gates (hard stops):
   - Failure to provide SOC2 or equivalent evidence within the security window.
   - Perf tests that exceed p95 thresholds by >25% (we treat as fail).
   - Legal redlines in SOW that cannot be resolved within two negotiation cycles.

3) Proposed evaluation timeline (FinLytics dates):
   - Kickoff: Nov 24, 2025
   - Security window complete: Dec 5, 2025
   - Perf & quality run: Dec 9–11, 2025
   - Executive review + procurement decision: target Dec 19, 2025

We attached: finlytics-security-questions.pdf and a scoring script. Once you update the MAP I can route to procurement and security.

Elena
